V1_AS_IS: Global roles and JWT/refresh; no clinic membership
V2_requirement: User membership per clinic and branch; current session/revoke
Migration_impact: Map user/global roles into verified memberships; do not auto-grant ADMIN to all clinics
Proposed_validation: A/B membership and stale JWT/revoke tests

V1_AS_IS: No clinic/branch/onboarding/publish service or tables in Maven modules
V2_requirement: Clinic-owned branch/license/review/publication and platform ops isolation
Migration_impact: Map all legacy rows to approved clinic/branch or quarantine
Proposed_validation: Submit/review/publish/suspend/draft denied

V1_AS_IS: No clinic/branch columns, request context or RLS in scanned backend
V2_requirement: Server-verified tenant+branch+object checks and fail-closed connection
Migration_impact: Every service-owned row requires ownership mapping and staged migrations
Proposed_validation: IDOR; reused pooled connection; mismatched branch

V1_AS_IS: Single patients table; user_id unique nullable; name/phone walk-in
V2_requirement: Global identity separate from clinic patient link; guardian verified
Migration_impact: No blind merge by phone; preserve legacy id/code
Proposed_validation: Clinic A/B patient links; mistaken duplicate; guardian revoke

V1_AS_IS: Doctor user_id unique; global specialty and weekly schedules
V2_requirement: Multi-clinic affiliation; branch schedule/leave/capacity
Migration_impact: Legacy doctor -> practitioner + clinic affiliation with verified source
Proposed_validation: Schedule A independent of B; deny unassigned

V1_AS_IS: Global medical_services / service_prices with valid date ranges
V2_requirement: Clinic/branch offerings and effective price versions; immutable snapshot
Migration_impact: Map global service/price to tenant offering without inventing historic price
Proposed_validation: Branch price isolation; price history immutable

V1_AS_IS: One doctor/date interval booking; GiST exclusion; no slot hold entity
V2_requirement: Tenant/branch scoped capacity, hold TTL, atomic reserve/idempotency
Migration_impact: Map appointment, status, doctor, temporal history; no destructive overwrite
Proposed_validation: Capacity 1 concurrency; hold timeout; reschedule swap

V1_AS_IS: reception_visit requires appointment_id NOT NULL; queue unique doctor/day
V2_requirement: Independent visit with nullable appointment_id, branch queue and assignment
Upstream_dependency: S0 clinic; S1 appointment; OD-04; Encounter ADR A03
Migration_impact: Preserve old appointment_id link as optional; map ticket/status, no fictitious booking
Proposed_validation: Booked and walk-in meet visit owner; one ticket active

V1_AS_IS: Single appointment-linked medical_record DRAFT/FINAL
V2_requirement: Encounter-linked immutable signed versions and separately released documents
Migration_impact: Historic signature evidence cannot be fabricated; preserve original rows/hash
Proposed_validation: Addendum, release scope and signed mutation blocked

V1_AS_IS: ORDERED→COLLECTED→PROCESSING→RESULTED→RELEASED; no distinct review state
V2_requirement: Order/result/review separate; awaiting-results preserved overnight
Migration_impact: Map existing results/author and provenance; do not infer doctor review from release
Proposed_validation: Result pending review overnight; assignment and branch access

V1_AS_IS: Draft/sign with catalog item link, appointment-based medical record
V2_requirement: Approved mandatory fields, signed evidence/version and release
Migration_impact: Preserve existing prescription item semantics; signed provenance only where real
Proposed_validation: Invalid sign denied; immutable signed/addendum

V1_AS_IS: Invoice one per appointment; cash-only capture/refund unique type; frozen sources
V2_requirement: Charge/bill/payment/partial/refund/ledger/beneficiary/reconcile
Migration_impact: Preserve payment transactions and reconciliation-required legacy rows; never invent paid
Proposed_validation: Partial payment, concurrent capture, owner-specific ledger

V1_AS_IS: Cash payment/refund attestation with item snapshot verification
V2_requirement: Retain idempotent audited onsite collection primitives
Migration_impact: Adapt to payment allocation/shift without mutating legacy evidence
Proposed_validation: Cash capture/replay and refund with actual DB locks

V1_AS_IS: No gateway/provider webhook routes; cash-only transaction provider
V2_requirement: Authenticated webhook/unknown/settlement/reversal
Migration_impact: No fake legacy gateway receipts
Proposed_validation: Signature, amount, merchant, duplicate, late callback

V1_AS_IS: IN_APP V1 event and recipient UUID; outbox publishers and consumer exist
V2_requirement: Tenant-safe, versioned non-PHI envelope; inbox/authenticated producer
Migration_impact: Version and rekey event/dedupe metadata, keep audit
Proposed_validation: Consumer replay, forged tenant payload, no PHI preview

V1_AS_IS: Scattered identity/doctor/catalog admin audits; medical audit
V2_requirement: Tenant/branch/correlation append-only security and business audit
Migration_impact: Do not rewrite original audit; provenance and hash
Proposed_validation: Actor, subject, action, result, clinic, branch, correlation

V1_AS_IS: One generic route gateway and patient-only dashboard aggregate
V2_requirement: Channel-aware public/workspace/platform API and context verification
Migration_impact: Version V2 routes; keep V1 routed separately
Proposed_validation: No client header trusted as auth; no cross channel leak

V1_AS_IS: Single signed-in app with global role priority
V2_requirement: Public unauthenticated + clinic workspace + separate platform mode
Migration_impact: Preserve V1 as transitional; reuse primitives selectively
Proposed_validation: Guest landing and tenant-role switch with cache invalidation

V1_AS_IS: No public listing/projection module/service or guest route
V2_requirement: Approved published only public projection and revalidated booking
Migration_impact: No patient/PHI in public projection
Proposed_validation: Draft/suspended excluded, stale source recheck

V1_AS_IS: Patient dashboard displays finalized medical records from my; no release artifact
V2_requirement: Only released per clinic, authorized patient/guardian
Migration_impact: Do not equate FINAL with released; preserve files/versions
Proposed_validation: Draft and signed-unreleased denied; revoke honored

V1_AS_IS: Single DB/user in compose; no RLS in scanned source
V2_requirement: Per-service least privilege and tenant RLS/connection guard
Migration_impact: Plan copy/backup, schema ownership, no V1 live table edits
Proposed_validation: GUC absent/wrong, connection pool reuse, restore

V1_AS_IS: Prometheus, Grafana, local DB volume; no verified restore evidence
V2_requirement: Tenant trace, PHI redaction, restore drill and service backup plan
Migration_impact: No production claims or data dump during audit
Proposed_validation: Synthetic restore, redacted trace, DLQ lag

V1_AS_IS: Global IDs/code and unscoped records; paid invoice quarantine migrations
V2_requirement: Verified old/new ID map, clinic owner, reconciliation and rollback
Migration_impact: Quarantine ambiguous clinic/branch, preserve original signatures/money
Proposed_validation: Isolated copy row/hash/payment reconciliation

V1_AS_IS: V1 /api routes, direct service calls with bearer header
V2_requirement: Versioned BFF/openapi/event contracts, idempotent errors
Upstream_dependency: Owners per service; ADR API path
Migration_impact: Additive V2 version; no silent V1 breaking change
Proposed_validation: Consumer contract and schema compatibility

V1_AS_IS: Global admin screens share clinic operational data
V2_requirement: Separate platform approval mode without default medical access
Migration_impact: Map legacy admin only when authorized by explicit role
Proposed_validation: Platform ops deny medical, clinic owner cannot approve self

V1_AS_IS: Unit/test source exists but no current runtime E2E proof
V2_requirement: Synthetic, cross-tenant, negative, backup, contract evidence gates
Migration_impact: Do not infer test pass from file presence
Proposed_validation: Traceability and signed A0 evidence
